title: The Legends Were True
description:
Entering into a pitch dark chamber, a sudden light pierces the darkness from above, just as the door slams behind you.

Illuminated before you appears to be a podium with a map on it. You feel compelled to take it.

Suspicious.
conditions: All players must have cards in deck
All players must have at least 10 HP
notes: This event presents a choice in a dark chamber with a mysterious map. Choosing to take the map grants the [gold]Spoils Map[/gold] quest card, which marks a treasure site worth [gold]600 Gold[/gold] in your next Act. Choosing to escape instead deals [red]8[/red] HP of unblockable, unpowered damage and provides a random [gold]Potion[/gold] reward.
